scenarios.title: Android CollectionView item-update and scroll stability
scenarios.rationale: RecyclerView observer, recycling, scrolling, and layout-manager behavior only execute on Android.
setup: Use the PR's functional reproduction page and the same data volume on base and head.
Use one fixed emulator/device image and build configuration for both commits.
Warm the app and collection before recording measurements.
operations: Apply the relevant collection mutation repeatedly.
Wait for scrolling and layout to settle after each mutation.
Verify the final visible item and offset so a faster but incorrect result cannot pass.
metrics: frame time and jank count during update/scroll
managed allocation and GC counts when instrumentation is available

scenarios.title: iOS and MacCatalyst CollectionView item-update and scroll stability
scenarios.rationale: ItemsViewLayout scroll-offset preservation executes inside UIKit collection updates.
setup: Use a fixed-size CollectionView with KeepItemsInView and identical data on base and head.
Use one fixed simulator/device runtime and build configuration for both commits.
Warm realization and scrolling before recording measurements.
operations: Scroll to a stable realized item and insert one item before the visible range.
Wait for collection updates and scrolling to settle after every insertion.
Record the first visible item so a faster jump to the beginning cannot be treated as equivalent.
metrics: first visible item after each update
layout invalidation counts when instrumentation is available
managed/native allocation deltas when instrumentation is available

scenarios.title: iOS and MacCatalyst CollectionView layout/ScrollTo stability
scenarios.rationale: UICollectionView measurement, compositional-layout invalidation, and ScrollTo behavior require UIKit.
setup: Use the PR's functional reproduction page with identical grouped data and cell sizes.
Use one fixed simulator/device runtime and build configuration for base and head.
Warm image/data loading before timing layout and scrolling.
operations: Reset to the top and repeat ScrollTo(MakeVisible, animated) to item 2 in section 1 at least ten times.
Wait for animation and layout to settle after every operation.
Verify the target item is visible and record its viewport position spread against the first measured result.
metrics: target viewport-position spread and count outside the 30px tolerance
layout invalidation and section-provider invocation counts
managed/native allocation deltas when instrumentation is available

scenarios.title: CarouselView disabled-swipe touch and layout handling
scenarios.rationale: Android disabled-swipe interception and UIKit's embedded orthogonal scroller require native CarouselView handlers.
setup: Create a non-looping CarouselView with swipe and bounce disabled from initial construction.
Use one fixed emulator/simulator/host and identical Release builds for base and head.
Warm native realization before recording measurements.
operations: On Android, exercise the native CarouselView interception path with repeated down/move/up sequences.
On iOS and MacCatalyst, reset the embedded scroller to UIKit defaults and invoke repeated layout passes.
Verify the head intercepts no disabled-swipe touches on Android and reapplies disabled swipe/bounce state on every Apple layout pass.
metrics: batched touch or layout-pass latency: median and p95
intercepted disabled-swipe touch count and final Android position
embedded Apple scroller count and state-reapplication failure count

scenarios.title: Windows CarouselView wheel-scroll centering
scenarios.rationale: WinUI ScrollViewer centering and realized CarouselView containers require Windows.
setup: Use a non-looping horizontal CarouselView with mandatory center snap points.
Use identical items, viewport, Windows App SDK, runtime, and Release settings for base and head.
Warm native realization and an initial centered position before measuring.
operations: Apply repeated native horizontal offset changes that model wheel-scroll bursts.
Wait for ViewChanged and CarouselView position updates to settle.
Verify the closest realized item is centered and Position/CurrentItem remain consistent.
metrics: maximum final center error in pixels
positions outside the one-pixel center tolerance
managed allocation and GC counts when instrumentation is available

scenarios.title: Windows CollectionView realization and scrolling
scenarios.rationale: ItemsRepeater realization, native scrolling, and WinUI layout require Windows.
setup: Use the same item template, item count, and viewport on base and head.
Warm realization before recording steady-state measurements.
operations: Repeat the affected mutation, realization, or scroll operation.
Verify the final realized range and scroll position.

scenarios.title: Android common control handler property-update batch
scenarios.rationale: Repeated property mapping and layout invalidation execute through native handlers for representative common controls.
setup: Create Label, Button, Entry, Picker, DatePicker, and TimePicker controls in one realized layout.
Use identical runtime, device image, viewport, and Release configuration for base and head.
operations: Update representative mapped properties on every control in one batch.
Measure and arrange the realized layout after each batch.
Verify native text/content values after every operation.

scenarios.title: Windows common control handler property-update batch
scenarios.rationale: Repeated property mapping and layout invalidation execute through WinUI handlers for representative common controls.
setup: Create Label, Button, Entry, Picker, DatePicker, and TimePicker controls in one realized layout.
Use identical Windows image, viewport, runtime, and Release configuration for base and head.
operations: Update representative mapped properties on every control in one batch.
Measure and arrange the realized layout after each batch.
Verify native text/content values after every operation.

scenarios.title: Cross-platform CollectionView handler scenario
scenarios.rationale: CollectionView handler behavior depends on native collection controls and is not exercised by the library-TFM benchmarks.
setup: Choose the platform and scenario that execute the changed handler path.
Use identical app data, viewport, runtime, and build settings for base and head.
operations: Repeat the affected scroll, update, or realization operation.
Assert functional equivalence before comparing performance.
metrics: allocation and GC counts where available

scenarios.title: Platform handler/layout hot-path scenario
scenarios.rationale: The changed code is excluded from the managed library TFM and requires its native platform.
setup: Construct or reuse a functional scenario that repeatedly executes the changed path.
Keep the device/runtime and build settings identical for base and head.
operations: Warm the scenario, then run interleaved base/head measurements.
Verify output and UI state after each operation.
metrics: frame time and jank when UI-bound
